questions.question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are of different heights. A is taller than only two people. D is shorter than only G. F is taller than A but shorter than B. C is shorter than E. How many people are shorter than E?
questions.solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are of different heights.

1) A is taller than only two people.

__ > __ > __ > __ > A > __ > __

2) D is shorter than only G.

G > D > __ > __ > A > __ > __

3) F is taller than A but shorter than B.

G > D > B > F > A > __ > __

4) C is shorter than E.

G > D > B > F > A > E > C

So, only one person is shorter than E

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fourth number in the same way as the first number is related to the second number and the fifth number is related to the sixth number?

54 : 3 :: ? : 4 :: 500 : 5
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (2nd number)**³** × (2nd number -1) = 1st number.

Now,

For, 54 : 3

⇒ (3)³ × (3 -1)

⇒ 27 × 2 = 54

For, 500 : 5

⇒ (5)3 × (5 -1)

⇒ 125 × 4 = 500

**Similarly, for, ? : 4**

**⇒ (4)³ × (4 -1)**

**⇒ 64 × 3 = 192.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the sixth number in the same way as the first number is related to the second number and the third number is related to the fourth number.

44 : 4 :: 287 : 7 :: ? : 10
questions.solution:
Logic: 2nd number **×** **{**(2nd number)² - (2nd number + 1)} = 1st number.

Now,

For, 44 : 4

⇒ 4 × (4² - 5)

⇒ 4 × 11 = 44

For, 287 : 7

⇒ 7 × (72 - 8)

⇒ 7 × 41 = 287

Similarly, for **? : 10**

**⇒ 10 × (102 - 11)**

**⇒ 10 × 89 = 890.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

options.text: Q is the husband of T.
M is the father's mother of Q.
C is the mother’s brother of S.
S is the father of Q.

questions.solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 -
 +
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Husband
 Sister
 
 

 

Given: ‘C + M – S × K – T ÷ Q’

It means: C is brother of M. M is mother of S. S is husband of K. K is mother of T. T is sister of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/152472675b4a51f56ec63612c3f96407d55be233fb45d81e92840bae718ad639.png] 

Q is the husband of T → False (Because, T is Sister of Q, and T's gender is not defined).

M is the father's mother of Q → True

C is the mother’s brother of S → True

S is the father of Q → True

Thus, Q is the husband of T is incorrect.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All holders are hangers.

All hangers are hammers.

Some hammers are axes.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some axes are hangers.

II. Some hammers are holders.

III. Some hangers are holders.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
All holders are hangers.

All hangers are hammers.

Some hammers are axes.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e83824d00ebe923a38093daf538f4cbdc54cbb0d5d26591daa365c0902951cb.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some axes are hangers - False (Because, No definite relation given between axes and hammers, so it can be possible only).

II. Some hammers are holders - **True (**Because, All holders are hammers, it also means Some holders are hammers).

III. Some hangers are holders -** True **(Because, All holders are hammers, it also means Some hangers are holders).

Thus, Only conclusions II and III follow.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 2".**

questions.question:
If ‘A’ stands for ‘÷’, ‘B’ stands for ‘×’, ‘C’ stands for ‘+’ and ‘D’ stands for ‘−’, what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

11 B 10 D 18 A 3 C 8 = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 11 B 10 D 18 A 3 C 8 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Alphabet
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 ÷
 ×
 +
 -
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using the BODMAS Rule, we get: 

11 × 10 - __**18 ÷ 3**__ + 8 = ?

⇒ __**11 × 10**__ - 6 + 8 = ?

⇒ __**110**__ - 6 __**+ 8**__ = ?

⇒ __**118 - 6**__ = 112

Hence, the correct option is "Option 1".
